lessons_used: Evidence for specific kinds of changes is still thin, as each category has only one completed test so far.
Predictions have consistently been too high compared to measured results.
No clear effect was seen for reordering sign-in steps (sign_in, reorder).
No clear effect was seen for introducing new flows on the home/waiting screen (home, new_flow).
Redesigning the finish step (finish, redesign) significantly hurt performance.

candidates.title: Account Recovery Explanation Banner
candidates.change: Adds a hint on the sign-in screen reassuring users that logging in with their original provider restores their existing pets and data.
candidates.why: Support received 8 emails about pets missing or reset after signing in again, making account identity confusing during login.

sign_in.hint: Use the same login method as before to restore your existing pets and progress.

guard.reason: Adds a sign-in hint explaining account recovery within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Addresses sign-in dropoff with strong support ticket evidence (8 emails); simple banner text addition.

candidates.title: Grid View Pet Selection
candidates.change: Swaps the pet selection screen to a clean grid layout so users can see all available pet options at a glance.
candidates.why: Adoption has a low conversion rate of 60.9% and takes a median of 89s, suggesting users take too long browsing pet options.

guard.reason: Redesigns pet selection layout without losing functionality or steps.

candidates.score_note: Adoption step has highest dropoff (39.1%) and high duration, though layout change requires a new UI build.

candidates.title: Welcome & Experience Preview Screen
candidates.change: Inserts a new introductory screen right after the story screen highlighting what to expect from your new companion.
candidates.why: Choose path has a median time of 8s but a mean time of 514s, indicating initial drop-off and hesitation before deciding a path.

new_welcome_overview.headline: Meet Your New Desktop Companion
new_welcome_overview.body: Choose a preset pet or design a custom companion that lives right on your desktop.

guard.reason: new screens need an _order that places them

candidates.title: Generation Time Estimate Indicator
candidates.change: Shows explicit estimated time remaining and progress indicator on the waiting screen while pet assets generate.
candidates.why: The home/waiting step takes a median of 201s and mean of 2336s, causing uncertainty about whether pet creation stalled.

waiting.hint: Pet generation usually takes around 2-3 minutes. You can safely minimize this window.

guard.reason: Adds accurate wait time indicator on waiting screen without false urgency.

candidates.score_note: Addresses huge mean duration (2336s) at home step, though previous home flow additions showed weak lift.

candidates.title: Preset Pet Selection Cards Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the friend choice area with choice cards component featuring distinct visual tags for instant selection.
candidates.why: Support recorded 3 emails about custom pet generation failing or looking wrong, making verified preset selection a smoother fallback.

guard.reason: Redesigns pet selection cards while fulfilling the job of picking a friend.

candidates.score_note: Both high adoption dropoff and support emails align, but full card redesign carries UI build cost and moderate redesign risk.

candidates.title: Desktop Ready Notification Toggle
candidates.change: Adds a notification toggle on the waiting screen so users get notified when pet generation finishes.
candidates.why: Mean wait time at the home stage is over 38 minutes (2336s), suggesting users wander away while waiting.

guard.reason: Adds a notification toggle on the waiting screen within onboarding limits.

candidates.score_note: Directly targets high mean wait times where users leave, requiring moderate implementation effort.

candidates.title: Companion Archetype Quiz Flow
candidates.change: Adds an interactive quiz screen before path choice that recommends the ideal pet personality archetype.
candidates.why: 23.8% of users drop off at choose_path without selecting an option; an interactive quiz builds early investment.

new_quiz_path.headline: What kind of companion do you need today?
new_quiz_path.body: Answer 2 quick questions to find your matching desktop companion vibe.

guard.reason: new screens need an _order that places them

candidates.title: Desktop Controls Explanation Copy
candidates.change: Updates home_intro body copy to explicitly instruct users how to interact, drag, hide, and summon their pet on the desktop.
candidates.why: Support received 3 confusion emails specifically asking how to control, hide, or talk to their pet post-onboarding.

home_intro.headline: Your Pet is Ready on Your Desktop!
home_intro.body: Right-click your pet anytime to hide, customize, or open settings. Drag with your mouse to move them around your screen.

guard.reason: Updates home intro copy within onboarding rules.

candidates.score_note: Finish step has 35.2% dropoff and support issues; copy updates are low cost and safer than full redesigns.

candidates.title: Desktop Controls Summary Screen
candidates.change: Adds a quick desktop control key guide screen right after home intro, detailing desktop shortcuts before completing.
candidates.why: Finish step drop-off is 35.2% and support shows user confusion on desktop controls after finishing setup.

new_controls_summary.headline: Essential Desktop Shortcuts
new_controls_summary.body: Right-click pet: Menu & Settings | Drag: Move pet | Double-click: Interact

candidates.title: Starter Accessory Selection Incentive
candidates.change: Adds a visual badge and headline offering a free starter accessory when completing photo upload.
candidates.why: Adoption stage sees significant drop-off (60.9% pass rate), needing extra motivation to push users through custom creation.

upload_photos.headline: Upload Photos & Claim Free Starter Scarf
upload_photos.hint: Your uploaded photo unlocks an exclusive custom color theme for your pet's first accessory.

guard.reason: Onboarding copy mentions free extras ('Claim Free Starter Scarf').
